description: This is a Python source file implementing service functions for managing class types and sessions in a gym management system, including creating, updating, deleting, and listing classes and sessions.

methods.name: Class create_class(db: Session, title: str, description: str | None, capacity: int)
methods.description: Creates a new class type with the specified title, description, and capacity.

methods.name: Class update_class(db: Session, class_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates an existing class type identified by class_id with new fields.

methods.name: None delete_class(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes the class type identified by class_id.

methods.name: list[Class] list_classes(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all class types.

methods.name: ClassSession create_session(db: Session, class_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, capacity: int)
methods.description: Creates a new class session with specified start and end times, capacity, and initializes spots_remaining.

methods.name: list[ClassSession] list_sessions(db: Session, class_id: int | None = None)
methods.description: Lists class sessions, optionally filtering by class_id, ordered by start_time.
